summary: Extends EAP and its keying hierarchy to support the EAP Re-authentication Protocol (ERP), an efficient way to re-authenticate without repeating the whole EAP exchange when moving to another authenticator. It works independently of the EAP method used. It was replaced by RFC 6696.

eli5.summary: When you move between Wi-Fi access points, logging in again from scratch is slow. This lets you show a quick pass from your earlier login. It has been replaced by RFC 6696.

questions: how to speed up wifi roaming authentication
